turns.text: boss i need a chalkboard note for the cafe before the rush, opening in like 40 min. the cortado got retuned. new bean blend, i dialed the grind and dose in this morning after a regular said it tasted flat yesterday. want the board to say its been dialed in 🔥

Happy to help. Here's a chalkboard-sized option:

**The cortado is back, dialed in.**
New blend, fresh grind, a little more dose.
Smooth, sweet, nothing flat about it.
Try one. ☕

If you tell me the actual dose and grind change, I can add it to the tasting card. Want a tasting-card blurb too?

yes pls. ok so ive been on the espresso bar three years so i know how it should taste, ive been pulling double ristretto tests with no milk between rushes to judge it. its sweet, caramel-ish, bit of dark chocolate at the end. dose went up a gram, grind a touch finer

Great details. Tasting card:

**The Cortado: Retuned**
Equal parts espresso and steamed milk, built on our new blend. Ground a touch finer and dosed a gram heavier, so the espresso holds up against the milk.
Tastes like: caramel sweetness, a bit of dark chocolate on the finish.

Short version for the chalkboard, if space is tight:
**Cortado, dialed in. Caramel, dark chocolate, zero flat.**
